title: Coverage of Compulsory Medical Insurance Policies for Domestic Helpers
what_it_is: Coverage of Compulsory Medical Insurance Policies for Domestic Helpers

sections.label: FDW insurance coverage sufficiency
sections.summary: Public hospital records show the $15,000 compulsory minimum coverage met 97% of FDW inpatient and day surgery bills over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Based on the records of public hospitals, the current compulsory minimum coverage of $15,000 was sufficient to meet 97% of all inpatient and day surgery bills for FDWs in the last three years.

sections.label: FDW bills above $15,000
sections.summary: Over three years, 170 FDWs incurred more than $15,000 in medical bills, averaging about 55 cases yearly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: Across the last three years, a total of 170 actually had incurred more than $15,000 of medical bills.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: On average, it is about 55 cases a year.

sections.label: Mental illness coverage exclusion
sections.summary: Mental illnesses are not covered, but some major illnesses such as heart conditions are.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: Mental illnesses are not covered but some major illnesses, such as heart conditions and all that.

sections.label: FDW insurance options and assistance
sections.summary: Employers may buy higher FDW insurance coverage, and those with genuine financial difficulties are encouraged to seek MSW assistance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: As it is now, although the mandatory, compulsory medical insurance for FDW is capped at $15,000, employers actually are at liberty to buy insurance that has a higher coverage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: So, we will continue to encourage our employment agencies to disseminate this information to employers that, for peace of mind, if they worry about the risk of higher medical costs in future, they have the option of buying higher insurance coverage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: From our statistics, very few employers are genuinely facing financial difficulties, like for the case that the Member mentioned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: I think, on average, there are three to four cases of FDW employers having to face medical claims of above $50,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: In the case of the Member's resident, he has the financial means to pay, so, he does not need assistance from the hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: But for those who genuinely have difficulties, they are always encouraged to approach the MSW for assistance.
